teamImage.description: An image the team uploads, in megabytes

userImage.description: An image a reader uploads (to a post, a comment or a message), in megabytes

importImage.description: An image an import copies from another tool, before it's re-encoded, in megabytes

teamFile.description: A file the team attaches to an article, in megabytes

teamVideo.description: A video the team uploads, in megabytes

projectQuotaMb.description: All of a project's uploads together, in megabytes

model.description: Every AI feature's model (an OpenRouter model id, or one your endpoint serves), where its own isn't set; Tuti's default without

support.description: The inbox's drafted replies and summaries' model, instead of `ai.model`

codeChanges.description: Autopilot's articles' model, instead of `ai.model` (without either, Autopilot's write model)

maxPrice.description: The most a model projects pick may cost, in dollars per million output tokens (a model without a price can't be picked under a cap); no cap without

levels.description: The Affordable and Best levels' models, by role: a level left out isn't offered, a role left out runs on Balanced's (the server's) model. Without, Tuti's own rows, unless a model above is set (then only Balanced and Custom)

model.description: The decision model, a Decisions API model through OpenRouter (not a chat model): it answers the gate, what a pull request does to posts and articles, and whether edits call for Verify. The default did best on code changes' evaluation set (a model id)

gate.description: The probability that users see the change, below which there's nothing to do (a number from 0 to 1)

maybe.description: Resolving a post: proposed, as "maybe", from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

likely.description: Resolving a post: proposed as likely from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

maybe.description: Moving a post forward: proposed, as "maybe", from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

likely.description: Moving a post forward: proposed as likely from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

maybe.description: Linking a post: below this the pull request isn't linked to it at all (links are only applied by themselves, see `autopilot.decisions.autoLink`) (a number from 0 to 1)

likely.description: Linking a post: an applied link is labelled likely from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

autoLink.description: A link Autopilot applies by itself from this probability (with "Link posts by itself" on); at least `autopilot.decisions.links.maybe` (a number from 0 to 1)

maybe.description: Editing an article: proposed, as "maybe", from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

likely.description: Editing an article: proposed as likely from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

maybe.description: A new article: proposed, as "maybe", from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

likely.description: A new article: proposed as likely from this probability (a number from 0 to 1)

diffChars.description: The pull request's diff the docs agent and the writers read, in characters (the decision model at most 20,000 of it); files past it are only listed (a whole number from 1000 to 500000)

fileChars.description: One file's share of the diff at most, in characters (a whole number from 500 to 500000)

bodyChars.description: The pull request's description it reads, in characters (a whole number from 0 to 100000)

outlineArticles.description: The help center's articles and drafts the docs agent is shown at most (published ones first); it finds the rest with its search (a whole number from 50 to 20000)

model.description: The docs agent's model: with the tools, it decides what each merged pull request means for the help center (which articles to fix, which new ones it needs) in one answer (a model id)

rounds.description: Its rounds of tool calls at most, before it must answer (a whole number from 1 to 50)

maxTokens.description: The most it writes in one reply, in tokens (the double-check's too) (a whole number from 500 to 64000)

temperature.description: Its temperature (the double-check's too): 0 for the steadiest answers (a number from 0 to 2)

reasoning.description: How much it thinks before each reply, as OpenRouter's reasoning effort (the double-check's too); off asks for none (one of off, low, medium, high)

model.description: The double-check's model: when the docs agent proposes a new article (see `autopilot.redecide.whenNewArticle`), it decides the pull request again from scratch, with the same tools, and its answer is used; it's also Checks' model on the Balanced level, which reviews every article edit. `off` skips both, and every article edit then asks first, except on a level whose `ai.levels` row or Custom setting gives Checks its own model (a model id, or off)

rounds.description: Its rounds of tool calls at most, before it must answer (a whole number from 1 to 50)

whenNewArticle.description: The double-check runs when the docs agent proposes a new article this sure or more (a number from 0 to 1)

model.description: The model that writes each edit and new article, with the same tools, and Autopilot's other text (the summary, reasons, the changelog line) and Verify's. A project's own pick for Autopilot wins, then `ai.features.codeChanges`, then `ai.model`, then this (a model id)

rounds.description: Its rounds of tool calls at most, for each edit or new article (a whole number from 1 to 50)

maxTokens.description: The most it writes in one reply, in tokens (a whole number from 500 to 64000)

listChars.description: List files: the answer's characters at most (a whole number from 1000 to 500000)

fileChars.description: Read a file: its characters at most (a whole number from 1000 to 500000)

searchLines.description: Search the code: the lines at most (a whole number from 1 to 1000)

searchChars.description: Search the code: the answer's characters at most (a whole number from 1000 to 500000)

searchMs.description: Search the code: how long one search may take, in milliseconds (the model writes the pattern) (a whole number from 100 to 60000)

articleChars.description: Read an article: its characters at most (a whole number from 1000 to 500000)

articles.description: Search articles: how many it finds when the model doesn't say (a whole number from 1 to 50)

maxArticles.description: Search articles: how many it finds at most (a whole number from 1 to 50)

embedMs.description: Search articles: how long one embeddings request may take, in milliseconds (a whole number from 1000 to 300000)

timeoutMinutes.description: How long one pull request's analysis may take, in minutes; past it the analysis fails and is tried again (a whole number from 1 to 60)

callTimeoutSeconds.description: How long one request to the docs agent's models may take, in seconds (a whole number from 10 to 900)

concurrentAnalyses.description: How many pull requests the worker analyses at once, on the whole server (retries included); the rest wait their turn. Each holds a worker slot for up to the analysis's time limit, and its repository in memory (a whole number from 1 to 20)

archiveBytes.description: The repository's text the docs agent may read, in bytes; over it, it works from the diff (and the analysis says so) (a whole number from 1000000 to 1000000000)

readBytes.description: The repository's archive unpacked, everything in it, in bytes at most (a whole number from 1000000 to 10000000000)

fileBytes.description: One file in the repository, in bytes at most; bigger ones are left out (a whole number from 10000 to 100000000)

downloadMs.description: How long downloading the repository may take, in milliseconds (a whole number from 5000 to 900000)

after.description: How sure the decision model must be that edits piling up on an article call for Verify, before Autopilot starts one (a number from 0 to 1)
